title: Build for What Comes Next: The 2026 Virtual Launch
title_zh: 面向未来的造物 · 2026 线上发布会全片
summary: At Street Corner, ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. opens the hood on NyxID, Ornn, CMA, heca, chrono-harness and sshx, from chrono-metaverse, chrono-cd and Living with AI to six launch roles including Finance NyxBot. In its own observatory, independent research organization The Omega Institute opens a pinned Lean 4 proof for inspection and records the open questions and Mathesis review counts alongside it. The interactive browser canvas uses still plates. The 1080p and 720p MP4 release masters composite five live 3D captures at 30 fps.
summary_zh: 在街角前厅，ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. 展示 NyxID、Ornn、CMA、heca、chrono-harness 与 sshx 如何支撑 chrono-metaverse、chrono-cd 和 Living with AI，并公开包括财务 NyxBot 在内的六个发布会岗位的实操边界。独立科研机构 The Omega Institute 则在自己的观测站里打开一条可核验的 Lean 4 反驳定理，列出开放问题与 Mathesis 审稿记录。浏览器交互画布版使用静帧底图。1080p 与 720p MP4 发行母版均以每秒 30 帧合成五段三维场景实录。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: Warm architectural stone for ChronoAI. Deep-space optical glass for the independent research of The Omega Institute. Interactive still-plate browser canvas and 30 fps live-3D composited MP4 release masters in 1080p and 720p.
